title: Help with programming a v-pet
author: BigOk9721
selftext:
Hey guys, I’ve never programmed anything really except trying out some codecamp, but that’s really it. Recently though I’ve been getting more and more obsessed with tamagotchi, digimons and v pets in general and I stumbled upon a video of a guy programming a v pet game using PICO-8, so I was wondering if a complete beginner like me could develop a game as well, leaning heavily on the idea of tamagotchi etc. I’ve always wanted to start coding so having this spark of interest would be really cool. Only thing is I really don’t have any idea about how anything works so any advice on where to start would be great.   
Thanks to everyone!

(Also English isn’t my first nor second language so pls don’t flame hahaha)

comments.author: Bratchan
comments.body: Just tell AI you want digimon original vpet mix with a tamagoachi. Tell it what things you want different and then give it images of what u want it to look like.

comments.author: damocles_paw
comments.body:
Go to claude.ai , set up your account, and tell it what you told us. 

After a minute it will stop and tell you your tokens are used up. Then you can wait 5 hours and continue for another minute, or pay money to go faster than that.

replies.author: BigOk9721
replies.body:
Lol thanks :v  
And here I was thinking I’d have to learn the basics from scratch hahahaha
